name: Necromancer: a Skeletal Mage only casts at targets within 40 yards
contract: A Skeletal Mage (50075) is a ranged minion without combat movement: it adopts its owner's target and casts its 801513 frost bolt every 3 s. 801513 is instant with SpellRange 13 'Anywhere' (50000 yd), so the engine sets no limit; like the 40 yd 'Command: Skeletal Mages' and the Frost Wyrm's breath targeting, the mage engages only an enemy within 40 yards and in line of sight, and drops a target that leaves that reach so it can follow its owner's next target. The owner first attacks a golem 46 yards away: the mage does not adopt it and casts nothing. The owner then attacks a golem 30 yards away: the mage adopts it and damages it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
SETUP: a Skeletal Mage is raised
The owner attacks the golem 46 yards away
Two of the mage's 3 s attack cycles pass
DISCRIMINATING: the mage cast nothing at the golem 46 yards away
The golem 46 yards away took no damage
The mage does not hold the golem out of reach
The owner switches to the golem 30 yards away
CONTROL: the mage casts at a target within 40 yards
CONTROL: the golem 30 yards away takes the mage's damage
